nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) holding token balances of every account.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) holding ERC20 allowances.
Public address of the Uniswap pair used for the max-wallet transfer restriction.
Public address exempt from the max-wallet transfer restriction.
Total token supply, initialized to 100_000_000_000 * 10**18 and mutable via setFeeTotal.
Public maximum amount allowed to be transferred into the Uniswap pair in a single transfer.
Private owner address stored by Ownable and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
EthMOON constructor: mints the whole supply to _msgSender() and emits Transfer.
Ownable constructor: sets _owner to _msgSender() and emits OwnershipTransferred.
ERC20 transfer: forwards to _transfer(_msgSender(), recipient, amount).
ERC20 transferFrom: calls _transfer then decreases the allowance via _approve.
ERC20 approve: calls _approve(_msgSender(), spender, amount).
Internal approval writer that validates addresses and writes _allowances.
Internal transfer logic: zero-address checks, max-wallet gate against _tUniswapPair/_tBlackAddress, balance updates.
onlyOwner setter writing _tUniswapPair with an arbitrary address.
onlyOwner setter writing _tBlackAddress with an arbitrary address.
onlyOwner function that increases _tTotal and mints the new amount to the owner via SafeMath.add.
onlyOwner function that recomputes _maxWallet from a caller supplied value multiplied by 10**18.
onlyOwner function emitting OwnershipTransferred(_owner, address(0)) without clearing _owner.
onlyOwner function assigning a new owner to _owner after a zero-address check.
Access-control gate requiring _owner == _msgSender() before protected functions execute.
Context helper returning msg.sender as address payable.
Library function sending ether with recipient.call{value: amount}("") after a balance check.
Library private function performing target.call{value: weiValue}(data) and bubbling up revert data.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller used for ownership, minting and transfer authorization.
Low-level external call with arbitrary target/recipient that transfers control and value, enabling reentrancy or arbitrary code execution.
Supply/balance mutation _tTotal.add(amount) and _balances[_msgSender()].add(amount) inside setFeeTotal (arithmetic risk if SafeMath assumptions change).
Multiplication _maxWalletPercent * 10**18 performed without SafeMath, an unchecked arithmetic operation on attacker-influenced input.
Balance arithmetic in _transfer: _balances[sender].sub(amount) and _balances[recipient].add(amount).
Allowance arithmetic in transferFrom: _allowances[sender][_msgSender()].sub(amount).
Calldata parameter newUniswaPair of setUniswapPair, written straight into _tUniswapPair.
Calldata parameter blackAddress of setBlackAddress, written straight into _tBlackAddress.
Calldata parameter amount of setFeeTotal, minted to the owner and added to _tTotal.
Calldata parameter _maxWalletPercent of setMaxWallet, multiplied by 10**18 to set _maxWallet.
Parameter sender of _transfer, used as the debited balance account.
Parameter recipient of _transfer, used as the credited balance account and compared with _tUniswapPair.
Parameter amount of _transfer, checked against _maxWallet and subtracted/added on balances.
Local variable msgSender in the Ownable constructor holding _msgSender() before assignment to _owner.

edges.reason: _msgSender() reads and returns msg.sender, propagating the untrusted caller.
The onlyOwner modifier compares _owner against msg.sender to authorize privileged calls.
setUniswapPair is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
setBlackAddress is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
setFeeTotal is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
setMaxWallet is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
The EthMOON constructor mints the entire supply to msg.sender.
The Ownable constructor stores msg.sender as the initial privileged owner.
Ownable constructor assigns the deployment caller into the _owner state variable.
The local msgSender captured in the Ownable constructor becomes the stored owner.
EthMOON constructor credits the initial _tTotal balance into _balances.
transfer forwards caller, recipient and amount into _transfer.
transferFrom first moves tokens through _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrease the spender allowance.
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
_approve writes the amount into the _allowances mapping.
_transfer reads and updates _balances for sender and recipient.
_transfer compares recipient against _tUniswapPair to apply the max-wallet gate.
_transfer compares sender against _tBlackAddress to bypass the max-wallet gate.
_transfer requires amount < _maxWallet for pair transfers.
_transfer performs balance subtraction and addition arithmetic on the transferred amount.
transferFrom subtracts the amount from the stored allowance using SafeMath.
setFeeTotal uses SafeMath.add to increase _tTotal and the owner balance.
setMaxWallet multiplies the caller parameter by 10**18 without SafeMath.
setFeeTotal mutates the total supply state variable _tTotal.
setMaxWallet mutates the _maxWallet state variable.
setUniswapPair writes the supplied address into _tUniswapPair.
setBlackAddress writes the supplied address into _tBlackAddress.
transferOwnership reassigns the privileged _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership reads _owner and emits a renounce event without clearing it.
sendValue executes the low-level value transfer to the recipient, handing control to external code.
The external recipient call can re-enter the calling contract before sendValue completes.
_functionCallWithValue performs the low-level call to an arbitrary target, giving control to external code.
The newUniswaPair parameter flows into the _tUniswapPair state variable.
The blackAddress parameter flows into the _tBlackAddress state variable.
The amount parameter is added to _tTotal and to the owner balance.
The _maxWalletPercent parameter is multiplied by 10**18 inside setMaxWallet.
The sender parameter flows into _transfer and is used as the debited account.
The recipient parameter flows into _transfer and is compared against _tUniswapPair.
The amount parameter flows into _transfer and drives the max-wallet check.
The transfer amount parameter is the operand of the balance subtraction and addition.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter exists only to be stored by setUniswapPair and carries no independent behavior.
The parameter exists only to be stored by setBlackAddress and carries no independent behavior.
The mint amount parameter is consumed solely by setFeeTotal's arithmetic and event.
The percent parameter is used only in setMaxWallet's multiplication.
The sender parameter only feeds the _transfer balance arithmetic.
The recipient parameter only feeds _transfer's pair check and balance credit.
The amount parameter is used only by _transfer's limit check and balance arithmetic.
The local msgSender is an intermediate copy of the caller inside the Ownable constructor.
